rules.statement: The FIFO transfers a stream of data words from the write clock domain to the unrelated read clock domain.
Words are read out in the same order in which they were written.
Write and read pointers cross between clock domains as Gray codes through configurable synchronizers.
The IP reports full, empty, full-with-threshold, empty-with-threshold, overflow, and underflow flags to the two domains.
The structural top m_vlsit_afifo_top instantiates the write module, the read module, and the FIFO array module.
The write module operates in the write clock domain and the read module in the read clock domain.
The synchronizer module instantiates one technology cell wrapper per bit, supporting five cell options (bypass, two D-FF cells, 2-FF, 3-FF, 4-FF), configurable bit width and configurable reset value.
The synchronizer module is the only module instantiating the cell wrapper, and the wrapper is the only module containing cells and the metastability model.
The FIFO array module provides a pure RTL implementation and a library SRAM (one write port, one read port) replacement branch.
Software reset is a reset input in the write clock domain using a four-phase handshake that resets both pointers in the right order and blocks both interfaces during the reset.
Verification-only models (synchronizer metastability model, SRAM macro model) and example technology cell models are provided.
The IP does not include reset synchronizers; each reset input must already be synchronized to its own clock.
The FIFO works with two asynchronous clocks with no restriction on frequency or frequency ratio.
The asynchronous FIFO with Gray-coded pointers feature (FEAT-001) is always present.
The FIFO has a configurable number of entries and data width.
The FIFO provides full and empty flags.
The FIFO provides full-with-threshold and empty-with-threshold flags.
The FIFO provides overflow and underflow flags.
The synchronizer has 2, 3, or 4 stages by cell option 1 to 4; option 0 is a bypass without stages.
The technology-cell synchronizer uses one cell wrapper per bit with PARA_AFIFO_CELL_TYPE: 0 bypass, 1 two D-FF cells, 2 one 2-FF cell, 3 one 3-FF cell, 4 one 4-FF cell.
The FIFO array may use the library SRAM branch when PARA_AFIFO_MEM_USE_MACRO is 1.
A synchronizer metastability simulation model is delivered as the simulation branch of cell wrapper m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync.
The SRAM macro model VLSIT_CELL_SRAM_1W1R, a synthesizable RTL stand-in of the library macro, is delivered.
Example technology cell models for simulation are delivered.
Software reset uses a four-phase handshake between the two domains.
